What the scope can include

A condition survey decides what should be retained, repaired or replaced.

Back to service, on planKitchen coordination and hospitality-grade finishes are sequenced around trading.
01Dining area remodelingRefresh seating, circulation, lighting, wall finishes and focal points.
02Kitchen upgradesCoordinate prep, cooking, washing, storage and service movement.
03Ventilation and gas coordinationPlan interfaces for extract, make-up air and gas systems within the scope.
04Counter and bar worksUpgrade ordering, display, service and beverage stations.
05Washroom refurbishmentRenew guest washrooms with durable, easy-care finishes.
06Terrace and frontage refreshImprove arrival, outdoor seating and visible brand touchpoints where included.

A process shaped for restaurant & café renovation

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Operations audit

Map covers, service flow, kitchen constraints and trading windows.

02

Renovation concept

Align atmosphere, layout and back-of-house priorities.

03

Technical coordination

Resolve kitchen equipment, ventilation, gas, electrical and plumbing interfaces.

04

BOQ and closed-window plan

Price the work and sequence noisy or disruptive tasks out of hours.

05

Commission and reopen

Test services, snag finishes, deep clean and hand over.
